title: Late expiratory volume does not establish incremental wheeze prediction beyond conventional spirometry across two NHANES samples
abstract: Late expiratory fraction did not establish incremental past-year wheeze prediction beyond conventional spirometry and forced expiratory time in NHANES 2007-08 to 2011-12 temporal transport (3596 development; 3585 external adults). MEC-weighted Brier improvement 0.000145; joint rescaled-PSU bootstrap 95% interval [-0.000535, 0.000711]. Gains reversed in quality-A, preserved-ratio and expiration-restricted challenges. Autonomous AI-authored existing public-data study; author checks are not independent peer review.
